# tcpshield_sentry_tunnel (Resource)

A Sentry tunnel: an account-level WireGuard tunnel that puts TCPShield's filtering in front of any TCP/UDP service. Install it on the origin with `tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_setup_script`, then open ports with `tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_firewall_rule`. **Not yet verified against the live API** — creation failed server-side on the test account (`Allocating not used IP address failed.`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_bind_port" "free" {}

resource "tcpshield_sentry_tunnel" "game" {
  name          = "game-server"
  endpoint_peer = "203.0.113.20"
  bind_port     = data.tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_bind_port.free.port

  # The suggested port changes on every read; keep the one the tunnel got.
  lifecycle {
    ignore_changes = [bind_port]
  }
}

data "tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_setup_script" "game" {
  tunnel_id = tcpshield_sentry_tunnel.game.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bind_port` (Number) Port the tunnel binds on TCPShield's side. `tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_bind_port` suggests a free one.
- `endpoint_peer` (String) Public address of the origin's WireGuard peer.
- `name` (String) Tunnel name, 3–50 characters.

### Optional

- `endpoint_public_key` (String) WireGuard public key of the origin's endpoint. TCPShield generates one on create; set it to bring your own key.
- `location` (String) Location key from `tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_locations` (e.g. `ANY`). Only settable on create — changing it replaces the tunnel.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `endpoint_private_key` (String, Sensitive) WireGuard private key TCPShield generated for the origin's endpoint.
- `id` (Number) Numeric tunnel id.
- `tunnel_addresses` (Attributes List) Addresses allocated to the tunnel. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tunnel_addresses))

<a id="nestedatt--tunnel_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tunnel_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `ip_address_private` (String) Private tunnel IP on TCPShield's side.
- `ip_address_public` (String) Public IP clients connect to.
- `location` (String) Location of the address.
- `peer_ip_address_private` (String) Private tunnel IP of the origin.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import tcpshield_sentry_tunnel.game <tunnel_id>
```
